contexts.text: All the arcana of mechanics are inscribed on and applied to (the body).
By the sciences, are meant experimental things of various kinds, mechanics, etc.

As concerns mechanical [science], when anyone indulges too much in mechanical practice, he then forms his mind so that he [believes] that there is nothing except what is mechanical; not only the whole of nature, but also spiritual and celestial things, of which, unless he can reduce them to mechanical principles and their powers, he believes nothing; so that he becomes corporeal and earthly. SE 769.
On mechanicians. (See Polhem, and at SE 6071.)
They who in the world have exercised arts from what is ingenious, as mechanics, etc., turn such things into magic. SE 5043:end. SE 5046.
They who were making these magical things, were chiefly mechanicians who in the world had denied God and eternal life...
Still there are many useful sciences, which strengthen and illustrate ideas; as all physical science... and especially that of experiment; as mechanics, etc.
